title: Daydream Believer | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Daydream Believer is a pet-friendly Seagrove escape with a boho beach style, LSV (golf cart) bikes, nearby beach access, a community pool, and nearby dining.
description_expanded: Daydream Believer (Seagrove) Features Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. Enjoy the included 6-seater LSV for exploring 30A (must sign a waiver for access) Community Pool is 150 footsteps from home - pool can be heated for an additional fee during cooler months with advance notice. As this is a community pool, we cannot guarantee pool heating will be available due to possible equipment malfunctioning. Enjoy 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape Beach supplies, beach chairs, beach umbrellas, bike trailer, and corn hole available 4 Minute Bike Ride to Eastern Lake Beach Access and Ramsgate Beach Access 4 Minute Drive to Walton Dunes Beach Access with beach service and beach bonfires available at this location Close to shopping and dining - 2-minute bike ride to Steamboat Grill, Beachy Bean Coffee Co, Old Florida Fish House, and Buddy's Seafood Market. 100 yards from Greenway Station with many shopping and dining options. Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances WIFI Covered porch with seating 2nd Floor TV room with large TV and high-top table for 2 Concierge services including beach chair rentals, golf cart rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rental available HE Washer and Dryer Charcoal grill Outdoor shower Driveway parking for 2 vehicles and garage parking for 1 vehicle - street parking and blocking the sidewalk is prohibited by the HOA. RVs or Trailers not allowed. At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Nestled away in the Greenway Park neighborhood, you'll LOVE Daydream Believer and all its charm. Impeccably decorated in a colorful beachy boho theme, this home is the Pinterest vacation spot of your dreams. Crisp whites and neutrals are the base for glorious colors and textures to shine, creating an irresistibly relaxing and inspiring atmosphere. Don't forget your furry family member either! Your dog wants to romp around 30A, too. This designer home and neighborhood is pet friendly. Greenway Park is conveniently located near THREE beach entrances. Stroll or bike down the pebbled path of May Street for a few minutes to reach the Eastern Lake Beach Access or Ramsgate Beach Access. Jump on the LSV for a quick 4-minute drive to the parking for the Walton Dunes beach access. It is faster to get to the beach from Daydream Believer (Seagrove) than if you were staying in some of the major 30A neighborhoods! Shopping and dining is a block away at Steamboat Grill, Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Bean Coffee Co, and Buddy's Seafood Market. Plus the new Greenway Station with even more shopping and dining option is just outside the neighborhood. * Discount applies to nightly rental rate before taxes and fees. The total discount available will display during check-out. Cannot be combined with other discounts or promos. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

2nd Floor King Suite 2 | private covered balcony with outdoor sofa, dresser and walk-in closet storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Guest Room | TV, dresser and closet storage, ensuite entrance to Jack and Jill shared bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor Bunk Room | sleeps 4 in Queen over Queen bunk, dresser and reach in closet storage, ensuite entrance to Jack and Jill shared bath with combination shower/tub

Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
